thread:
maya: Quick sync — planning a staggered rollout for the SDK adapter shim (v2.1) tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need canary owner, client comms owner, and rollback owner. ETA for final cutover window is 10:00–11:00 PT.

zach: I can take canary monitoring + smoke tests. Will run through the checklist at 09:30 PT and be online for the 10:00 cut.

anita: I can own rollback plan + verifying telemetry hooks. Will prepare a rollback playbook and a Prometheus dashboard snippet.

maya: Thanks. @zach please focus on latency p95 and error-rate thresholds (alerts), and verify prefix caching behavior.

zach: noted. Thresholds: latency p95 > 120ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% triggers rollback. I'll wire alerts to #eng-oncall too.

kyle: I'll send the client comms draft for SDK consumers. Two things to include: compatibility matrix and known-behavior changes for streaming + function calling.

ellie: I'll run a quick compatibility smoke against our internal integrations (payments, search) at 09:40 PT. If anything fails I'll post stack traces here.

maya: deploy-bot, reserve deploy window and attach canary bucket config.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18 10:00-11:00 PT. Canary bucket: 5% -> 25% -> 100% staged, each step 10m quiesce. Rollback endpoint: /internal/rollbacks/sdk-adapter-v2.1.

anita: Rollback playbook (draft):
```
1) Pause traffic in routing layer: `rdr-rt disable-route sdk-adapter`
2) Trigger rollback endpoint with request id and target version
3) Re-home KV caches: run `rdr-cache-sync --from v2.1 --to v2.0`
4) Notify clients via comms channel + incident notes
```

zach: Quick note — ensure we tag telemetry events with `adapter_version` and `canary_bucket` so we can slice metrics.

maya: agreed. Kyle, post comms in #product-integrations and include rollback timeline + contact list.

kyle: Will do. Draft incoming in 30m.

ellie: If all good, I'll thumbs-up once internal smoke passes. If I hit anything flaky, I'll post minimal repro and assign to the owning PR.

maya: Final ask: take screenshots of the smoke-run dashboards and upload them here after 09:45 PT. Also keep a short note if any client-facing change requires migration steps.

zach: Will post dashboard links. :thumbsup:

anita: Rollback playbook ready — ping me during roll. I'll be on standby 09:45–11:15 PT.

maya: perfect. cadence: 09:30 preflight, 09:45 smoke, 10:00 start canary, 10:10 expand, 10:20 expand, 10:30 full cut. If any stage fails, we rollback immediately.

kyle: noted. I'll also add a short FAQ for SDK users explaining the shim behavior and backcompat expectations.

\zmaya: (typo) ignore — everything set.

maya: thanks all. post-rollout retrospective thread will go to #eng-releases with artifacts and perf numbers.
